parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey cylindrical body with horizontal ribs, matte plastic finish.
physics.Functional_description: Main buoyant housing containing the switching mechanism and providing flotation.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical body firmly from the sides using a parallel jaw gripper.
physics.reason: Must be hollow and lightweight to float; thin injection-molded plastic walls enclose air and internal components.

parts.description: Dark grey cylindrical body with horizontal ribs, matte plastic finish.
parts.function: Main buoyant housing containing the switching mechanism and providing flotation.

parts.name: front label

physics.Basic_description: Small rectangular label area on the side of the body, likely printed or adhered.
physics.Functional_description: Displays branding, specifications, or orientation markings.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flat to be grasped independently; part of the surface texture.
physics.reason: A thin film or print layer is effectively a solid sheet relative to its negligible thickness.

parts.description: Small rectangular label area on the side of the body, likely printed or adhered.
parts.function: Displays branding, specifications, or orientation markings.

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: Grey ribbed cap or collar at the top end, slightly wider than the body.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the cable entry point and allows for adjustment or sealing.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the rim or knurled edges, though smaller than the main body.
physics.reason: Molded plastic cap structure enclosing the cable seal mechanism.

parts.description: Grey ribbed cap or collar at the top end, slightly wider than the body.
parts.function: Secures the cable entry point and allows for adjustment or sealing.

parts.name: pump head shell

physics.Basic_description: Small protrusion or tab on the upper surface of the body.
physics.Functional_description: Likely a mounting tab, pivot point, or part of the internal switch housing exterior.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integrated to grasp safely without slipping.
physics.reason: Small feature likely solid plastic or thick-walled enough to approximate as solid for manipulation physics.

parts.description: Small protrusion or tab on the upper surface of the body.
parts.function: Likely a mounting tab, pivot point, or part of the internal switch housing exterior.

parts.name: dip tube

physics.Basic_description: Thin black flexible wire or cable extending from the bottom of the unit.
physics.Functional_description: Electrical connection cable transmitting the switch signal.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pinched by a gripper but is flexible and prone to slipping or bending.
physics.reason: Cables are treated as solid rods/cylinders for manipulation purposes despite internal strands.

parts.description: Thin black flexible wire or cable extending from the bottom of the unit.
parts.function: Electrical connection cable transmitting the switch signal.

parts.name: spout shell

physics.Basic_description: Small loop or tab feature near the top collar.
physics.Functional_description: Attachment point for a counterweight or tether chain.
physics.Grasped_description: Could be hooked or pinched, but offers poor leverage compared to the body.
physics.reason: Small structural tab is likely solid plastic to withstand tension.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
